描述_EN: nineteenth century german trade books show illustrations of toys using air to produce sound or movement. when released, the wings close and the bellows make a sound. the toy is hand held and operated by squeezing a loop of metal which extends from the tail and curves round to attach to bars under the wings. bellows have been a source of inspiration in the making of mechanical toys for centuries. as the loop is squeezed the wings open and extend the paper bellows. between the body and the wings of the bird is a tube of folded paper which acts as a bellows. this bird is a lithographed tin plate example from china, made for the local market.
描述_ZN: 19世纪的德国贸易书显示了使用空气来产生声音或运动的玩具的插图。 当释放时，翅膀关闭，风箱发出声音。 该玩具是手握的，通过挤压一个金属环来操作，这个金属环从尾巴上延伸出来，绕着翅膀下的杆子转。 几个世纪以来，风箱一直是制作机械玩具的灵感来源。 随着金属环被挤压，翅膀打开并延伸出纸质风箱。 在鸟的身体和翅膀之间有一个折叠的纸管，作为风箱使用。 这只鸟是来自中国的石印锡板例子，为当地市场制作。
